family_facing_reading: Start with the exact presidential or executive memorandum.
Identify the Act of Congress that the memorandum claims to implement, interpret, or rely on.
Find the official memorandum text or presidential document in the Federal Register when applicable.
Trace any spending, withholding, transfer, grant, or implementation step to the enacted appropriations authority.
REPLAY the chain from memorandum to statute to receipt to money.
HOLD until one specific memorandum is bound to one specific statute and appropriations path.

family_posture.message: Show the memo. Show the law. Show the publication. Show the money. Replay it.

next_input: A specific executive memorandum title, date, identifier, or claim for replay.
